sentence: Shows two cars with a fixed number of seats each, lets each person tap an open seat to claim or release it, and lets each person hold one extra seat for a guest.
use_when: A group needs to sort out who rides in which car for a trip or event
People should pick their own seat in a car with a set number of seats
Someone wants to save a seat for a guest who is not in the chat
The group wants to see who still has no ride
dont_use_when: The group needs to split costs or gas money for the trip
The plan needs routes, maps or live location sharing
The cars, drivers or seat counts need to change, since they are fixed
A general vote or poll on a time or place is needed
